tasks.label: Java: compilar questão 1
tasks.command: $sources = Get-ChildItem '${workspaceFolder}\questao1\src\*.java' | ForEach-Object FullName; $compiler = (Get-Command javac -All | Where-Object { $_.Source -notmatch '\\Oracle\\Java\\javapath\\' } | Select-Object -First 1).Source; if (-not $compiler) { throw 'JDK compiler not found. Install JDK 21 or newer.' }; & $compiler -encoding UTF-8 -d '${workspaceFolder}\questao1\out' $sources; exit $LASTEXITCODE
